questions.label: MCQ1
questions.question:
In the photoelectric effect, the minimum frequency of light required to eject electrons from a metal surface is called the ...

A threshold frequency.
B work function.
C maximum frequency.
D stopping potential.

(2)

questions.label: MCQ2
questions.question:
Light of a certain frequency is incident on a metal surface. The intensity of the light is increased while the frequency remains constant. Which ONE of the following statements is CORRECT?

A The maximum kinetic energy of the emitted electrons increases.
B The maximum kinetic energy of the emitted electrons remains constant.
C The number of electrons emitted per second decreases.
D No electrons will be emitted.

(2)

B A straight line with a positive gradient, with a positive y-intercept.
C A straight line with a negative gradient.
D A curve with a positive gradient.

(2)

A The maximum kinetic energy of electrons from X is greater than that from Y.
B The maximum kinetic energy of electrons from Y is greater than that from X.
C The maximum kinetic energy of electrons from both metals is the same.
D No electrons will be emitted from either metal.

(2)
